verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, linked from its machine-readable llms.txt index alongside a plain-text generated endpoint and schema reference (/llms-api.txt). A live probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200 with a parseable OpenAPI document ("Ramp Developer API" v1, 174 paths), and the unauthenticated Developer MCP server also exposes OpenAPI schemas to agents, with a probe verifying it is keyless.
